notes:
Prospect: Ironwood Support AI — customer-facing support platform for 150+ merchants. Looking to replace homegrown heuristics with ML-powered summarization + auto-tagging.

Key pain points / ask:
- Ticket/email summarization quality: one-sentence TL;DR + bulleted action items for agents.
- Auto-tagging accuracy for routing (fraud, returns, shipping, legal) — downstream workflows in Zendesk triggers and Freshdesk macros.
- Reliability under spikes: They saw 10x load during promo events; need predictable latency and fallbacks.
- Tool-calling: want Redwood to populate Zendesk ticket fields + trigger macros (safe sandboxing required).
- Compliance: EU data residency for EU merchants; SSO/SAML for internal staff; KMS for keys; configurable retention and audit logs for regulated partners.

Timeline / recent activities (high-level):
- 2026-01-30 Account created. Initial discovery form filled.
- 2026-02-04 Intro call (AE Maya Chen + SE Liam) — high level use-case and metrics collected.
- 2026-02-18 POC kickoff call (Fireflies id: ff_20260218_ironwood_poc_kickoff). Discussed Zendesk app model and tagging taxonomy. Action: provide sample ticket set.
- 2026-02-25 Security questionnaire submitted; asked clarifications on data residency and KMS.
- 2026-03-02 Demo of Redwood hosted pipeline for summarization with sample data (internal feedback: concise summaries, but occasional hallucinated action items).
- 2026-03-08 Follow-up: agreed to run 2-week POC focused on: (1) summarization quality on 10k tickets, (2) auto-tagging precision/recall, (3) scale test to 1k rps. Legal sign-off pending.

POC success criteria (draft):
- Summaries: avg. agent time saved >= 12s/ticket; NPS internal > baseline.
- Tagging: precision >= 88% and recall >= 82% across priority tags.
- Reliability: <1% error rate on tag application during 1k rps sustained for 15m.
- Integrations: Zendesk/Freshdesk app must reliably populate fields and trigger macros without manual steps.

Direct quotes / snippets from calls:
- "We need something that gives agents a single-screen TL;DR — not another long doc." — Head of CX.
- "Can you do deterministic tagging? We have compliance checks that must not miss fraud flags." — Fraud ops.

Technical notes / constraints:
- Prefer limited-model strategy: primary model for summaries, tiny fallback model for deterministic tag heuristics.
- Want to evaluate Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching, quantization) to hit cost targets during peak traffic.
- Requires an audit log per ticket-level modification with who/what and KMS-wrapped keys.
- Zendesk app will need to be approved by platform team; create separate sandbox tenant for POC.
